The dividend of $0.375 per common share is payable December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record on December 1, 2026. articles.summary: Visteon’s Cellular Network Access Device modules support integrated and standalone telematics solutions for Indian and global automotive markets. CHENNAI, India, November 24, 2026 – Visteon Corporation (Nasdaq: VC), a global leader in automotive technology, has launched a new production line for Cellular Network Access Device (NAD) modules at its Chennai manufacturing plant. The investment expands Visteon’s local manufacturing capabilities in India. The new production line was inaugurated by Sachin Lawande, President and Chief Executive Officer, joined by members of Visteon’s leadership team. This strengthens Visteon’s regional supply chain and establishes India as a manufacturing base for Cellular NAD technology serving customers worldwide. Part of Visteon’s integrated and standalone telematics solutions, the Cellular NAD module brings enhanced connectivity capabilities to vehicle platforms.
